mandate: PRIORITY 7 / Campaign #3 Deliverable A — new pre-stated real-spot family: range-bound breakout-reversion with volatility band (Bollinger range; breakout entry only in causal vol band; reversion-to-mid exit). Genuinely different from P6 Donchian breakout+volfilter. Real cached spot only; fail-closed.
supersedes_prior_family_artifacts_note: Does NOT relabel P6 Donchian volfilter; different structure (BB range + vol-band breakout entry + MA reversion exit).

family.name: range_breakout_reversion_volband
family.description: Bollinger range MA(20)±2*std defines range. Realized vol = rolling std of 1h returns over 24 bars. Causal vol band = [q25,q75] of vol over 240 bars (min 120). Entry (breakout in vol band): long if close crosses above upper while vol in band; short if crosses below lower while vol in band. Exit (reversion leg): if long, exit to flat when close < MA (revert to mid); if short, exit when close > MA. Long/short allowed. Position shifted by 1 bar for execution.

params.entry: breakout: long if prev close <= upper_prev and close > upper and vol in band; short symmetric vs lower
params.exit_reversion_leg: if long and close < MA exit to flat; if short and close > MA exit to flat (fade/revert to mid)

config.benchmark: buy-and-hold per asset (gross, no recurring turnover cost) on same OOS WF windows; strategy net of stated fee+slippage per turnover
config.pre_stated_oos_edge_proven_rule: oos_edge_proven=true IFF executed exposure/trades > 0 AND for ALL cost-grid slices: OOS net sum > 0 AND OOS net sum > B&H OOS sum on same WF windows. Else false (fail-closed). No in-sample tuning.
